title: chaerophyllum eriopodum
intro: Chaerophyllum eriopodum, commonly known as Mountain Carrot or Eared Chaerophyllum, is a perennial plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chaerophyllum eriopodum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, that have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Research has identified the presence of compounds such as apiol and myristicin in Chaerophyllum eriopodum, which contribute to its bioactive properties.
